题目内容: 【例3.4】已知 $n$ 维向量 $\pmb{\alpha}_{1},\pmb{\alpha}_{2},\pmb{\alpha}_{3}$ 线性无关，证明 $3\pmb{\alpha}_{1} + 2\pmb{\alpha}_{2},\pmb{\alpha}_{2} - \pmb{\alpha}_{3},4\pmb{\alpha}_{3} - 5\pmb{\alpha}_{1}$ 线性无关.
解析:
（方法一）（用定义，重组）设

$$
k _ {1} (3 \pmb {\alpha} _ {1} + 2 \pmb {\alpha} _ {2}) + k _ {2} (\pmb {\alpha} _ {2} - \pmb {\alpha} _ {3}) + k _ {3} (4 \pmb {\alpha} _ {3} - 5 \pmb {\alpha} _ {1}) = \mathbf {0},\tag{①}
$$

即 $(3k_{1} - 5k_{3})\pmb{\alpha}_{1} + (2k_{1} + k_{2})\pmb{\alpha}_{2} + (-k_{2} + 4k_{3})\pmb{\alpha}_{3} = \mathbf{0}$ .

② 

由于 $\pmb{\alpha}_{1},\pmb{\alpha}_{2},\pmb{\alpha}_{3}$ 线性无关，故

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 k _ {1} - 5 k _ {3} = 0, \\ 2 k _ {1} + k _ {2} = 0, \\ - k _ {2} + 4 k _ {3} = 0. \end{array} \right.\tag{③}
$$

因为 $\begin{vmatrix}3&0&-5\\2&1&0\\0&-1&4\end{vmatrix}=22\neq0$ ,齐次方程组③只有零解

$$
k _ {1} = 0, k _ {2} = 0, k _ {3} = 0.
$$

故向量组 $3\alpha_{1} + 2\alpha_{2}, \alpha_{2} - \alpha_{3}, 4\alpha_{3} - 5\alpha_{1}$ 线性无关.

(方法二) (用秩) 令 $\beta_{1}=3\alpha_{1}+2\alpha_{2},\beta_{2}=\alpha_{2}-\alpha_{3},\beta_{3}=4\alpha_{3}-5\alpha_{1}$ ，则

$$
\left[ \boldsymbol {\beta} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {\beta} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\beta} _ {3} \right] = \left[ \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3} \right] \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 3 & 0 & - 5 \\ 2 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 & 4 \end{array} \right].
$$

因为矩阵 $\begin{bmatrix} 3 & 0 & -5 \\ 2 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 4 \end{bmatrix}$ 可逆，所以 $r(\pmb{\beta}_1, \pmb{\beta}_2, \pmb{\beta}_3) = r(\pmb{\alpha}_1, \pmb{\alpha}_2, \pmb{\alpha}_3) = 3$ ，即 $\pmb{\beta}_1$ ， $\pmb{\beta}_2, \pmb{\beta}_3$ 线性无关，亦即 $3\pmb{\alpha}_1 + 2\pmb{\alpha}_2, \pmb{\alpha}_2 - \pmb{\alpha}_3, 4\pmb{\alpha}_3 - 5\pmb{\alpha}_1$ 线性无关.

题目内容: 【例3.5】设 A 是 n 阶矩阵， $\alpha$ 是 n 维列向量，若 $A^{m-1}\alpha \neq 0, A^{m}\alpha = 0$ ，证明向量组 $\alpha, A\alpha, A^{2}\alpha, \cdots, A^{m-1}\alpha$ 线性无关.
解析:
（方法一）（用定义，同乘）设

$$
k _ {1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} + k _ {2} \mathbf {A} \boldsymbol {\alpha} + k _ {3} \mathbf {A} ^ {2} \boldsymbol {\alpha} + \dots + k _ {m} \mathbf {A} ^ {m - 1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} = \mathbf {0},
$$

学习札记

① 

由 $A^{m}\alpha = 0$ 知 $A^{m+1}\alpha = 0, A^{m+2}\alpha = 0, \cdots$ ，用 $A^{m-1}$ 左乘①式两端，并把 $A^{m}\alpha = 0, A^{m+1}\alpha = 0, A^{m+2}\alpha = 0, \cdots$ 代入，

$$
k _ {1} \mathbf {A} ^ {m - 1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} = \mathbf {0}.\tag{②}
$$

因为 $A^{m-1}\alpha \neq 0$ ，故 $k_{1} = 0$ 。

把 $k_{1} = 0$ 代入 ① 式，有

$$
k _ {2} \mathbf {A} \boldsymbol {\alpha} + k _ {3} \mathbf {A} ^ {2} \boldsymbol {\alpha} + \dots + k _ {m} \mathbf {A} ^ {m - 1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} = \mathbf {0}.
$$

同理用 $A^{m - 2}$ 左乘上式，可知

$$
k _ {2} \mathbf {A} ^ {m - 1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} = \mathbf {0},
$$

从而 $k_{2} = 0$ 

类似可得 $k_{3}=0,\cdots,k_{m}=0$ ，所以 $\alpha,A\alpha,A^{2}\alpha,\cdots,A^{m-1}\alpha$ 线性无关.

（方法二）（反证法）如果 $\alpha, A\alpha, \cdots, A^{m-1}\alpha$ 线性相关，则有不全为 0 的 $k_{1}, k_{2}, \cdots, k_{m}$ 使得

$$
k _ {1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} + k _ {2} \mathbf {A} \boldsymbol {\alpha} + \dots + k _ {m} \mathbf {A} ^ {m - 1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} = \mathbf {0}.\tag{③}
$$

设 $k_{1}, k_{2}, \cdots, k_{m}$ 中第一个不为 0 的是 $k_{p}$ （即 $k_{1} = k_{2} = \cdots = k_{p-1} = 0, k_{p} \neq 0, p \geqslant 1$ ），于是 ③ 式化为

$$
k _ {p} \mathbf {A} ^ {p - 1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} + \dots + k _ {m} \mathbf {A} ^ {m - 1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} = \mathbf {0}.\tag{④}
$$

用 $A^{m-p}$ 乘④并把 $A^{m}\alpha = 0, A^{m+1}\alpha = 0, \cdots$ 代入，就有 $k_{p}A^{m-1}\alpha = 0$ . 又因 $A^{m-1}\alpha \neq 0$ ，那么 $k_{p} = 0$ ，与假设矛盾. 故 $\alpha, A\alpha, A^{2}\alpha, \cdots, A^{m-1}\alpha$ 线性无关. 展示新知

题目内容: 【例3.6】设 $\mathbf{A}$ 是 $n$ 阶矩阵， $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}$ 是 $n$ 维列向量，若 $A\alpha_{1} = \alpha_{1} \neq 0, A\alpha_{2} = \alpha_{1} + \alpha_{2}, A\alpha_{3} = \alpha_{2} + \alpha_{3}$ ，证明向量组 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}$ 线性无关.
解析:
（用定义，同乘）设

$$
k _ {1} \pmb {\alpha} _ {1} + k _ {2} \pmb {\alpha} _ {2} + k _ {3} \pmb {\alpha} _ {3} = \mathbf {0},\tag{①}
$$

由于 $(\mathbf{A} - \mathbf{E})\pmb{\alpha}_1 = \mathbf{0}, (\mathbf{A} - \mathbf{E})\pmb{\alpha}_2 = \pmb{\alpha}_1, (\mathbf{A} - \mathbf{E})\pmb{\alpha}_3 = \pmb{\alpha}_2$ ，用 $\mathbf{A} - \mathbf{E}$ 左乘 ① 式两端，得

$$
k _ {2} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + k _ {3} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} = \mathbf {0}.\tag{②}
$$

再用 A-E 左乘 ② 式两端, 有

$$
k _ {3} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} = \mathbf {0}.
$$

因为 $\alpha_{1} \neq 0$ ，故 $k_{3} = 0$ 。把 $k_{3} = 0$ 代入②得 $k_{2} = 0$ ，再把 $k_{2} = 0, k_{3} = 0$ 代入①得 $k_{1} = 0$ 。

因此，向量组 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}$ 线性无关.

题目内容: 【例3.7】（2008， $^{2}_{3,4}$ ）设A为三阶矩阵， $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2}$ 为A的分别属于特征值-1,1的特征向量，向量 $\alpha_{3}$ 满足 $A\alpha_{3}=\alpha_{2}+\alpha_{3}$ ，证明 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 线性无关.
解析:
$$
\mathbf {A} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} = - \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1}, \mathbf {A} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} = \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}.
$$

设

$$
k _ {1} \pmb {\alpha} _ {1} + k _ {2} \pmb {\alpha} _ {2} + k _ {3} \pmb {\alpha} _ {3} = \mathbf {0},\tag{①}
$$

用 A 左乘 ① 得

$$
- k _ {1} \pmb {\alpha} _ {1} + k _ {2} \pmb {\alpha} _ {2} + k _ {3} (\pmb {\alpha} _ {2} + \pmb {\alpha} _ {3}) = \mathbf {0},\tag{②}
$$

① - ② 得

$$
2 k _ {1} \pmb {\alpha} _ {1} - k _ {3} \pmb {\alpha} _ {2} = \mathbf {0}.
$$

因为 $\pmb{\alpha}_{1},\pmb{\alpha}_{2}$ 是不同特征值的特征向量， $\pmb{\alpha}_{1},\pmb{\alpha}_{2}$ 线性无关，故 $k_{1} = 0, k_{3} = 0$ 。代入(1)得 $k_{2}\pmb{\alpha}_{2} = \mathbf{0}$ 。又因 $\pmb{\alpha}_{2}$ 是特征向量， $\pmb{\alpha}_{2} \neq \mathbf{0}$ ，从而 $k_{2} = 0$ 。因此， $\pmb{\alpha}_{1},\pmb{\alpha}_{2},\pmb{\alpha}_{3}$ 线性无关。

（方法二）（反证法）因为 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}$ 是矩阵 A 不同特征值的特征向量，所以它们线性无关。那么如果 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}$ 线性相关，则

$$
\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3} = k _ {1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + k _ {2} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}.\tag{③}
$$

用 A 左乘 ③ 式两端，并把 $A\alpha_{1} = -\alpha_{1}, A\alpha_{2} = \alpha_{2}, A\alpha_{3} = \alpha_{2} + \alpha_{3}$ 代入得

$$
\pmb {\alpha} _ {2} + \pmb {\alpha} _ {3} = - k _ {1} \pmb {\alpha} _ {1} + k _ {2} \pmb {\alpha} _ {2}.\tag{④}
$$

④ - ③ 得 $\pmb{\alpha}_{2} = -2k_{1}\pmb{\alpha}_{1}$ , 与 $\pmb{\alpha}_{1}, \pmb{\alpha}_{2}$ 线性无关相矛盾.

题目内容: 【例3.8】设 A 是 $m \times n$ 矩阵，秩 $r(A) = n, \alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}$ 是 n 维线性无关的列向量。证明 $A\alpha_{1}, A\alpha_{2}, A\alpha_{3}$ 线性无关。
解析:
（方法一）（用定义）设

即

$$
\begin{array}{l} k _ {1} \mathbf {A} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + k _ {2} \mathbf {A} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} + k _ {3} \mathbf {A} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3} = \mathbf {0}, \\ \mathbf {A} (k _ {1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + k _ {2} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} + k _ {3} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}) = \mathbf {0}. \end{array}\tag{①}
$$

因 $r(A) = n, Ax = 0$ 只有零解，故

$$
k _ {1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + k _ {2} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} + k _ {3} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3} = \mathbf {0}.\tag{②}
$$

由 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 线性无关，从而 $k_{1}=0,k_{2}=0,k_{3}=0$ ，所以 $A\alpha_{1},A\alpha_{2},A\alpha_{3}$ 线性无关.

(方法二) (用秩)

$$
(A \alpha_ {1}, A \alpha_ {2}, A \alpha_ {3}) = A (\alpha_ {1}, \alpha_ {2}, \alpha_ {3}).
$$

因 A 是 $m \times n$ 矩阵, $r(A) = n$ ,

$$
r \left(\mathbf {A} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1}, \mathbf {A} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}, \mathbf {A} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}\right) = r \left[ \mathbf {A} \left(\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}\right) \right] = r \left(\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}\right) = 3.
$$

$\therefore A\alpha_{1}, A\alpha_{2}, A\alpha_{3}$ 线性无关.

题目内容: 【例3.9】设四维列向量 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}$ 线性无关，且与四维非零列向量 $\beta_{1}, \beta_{2}$ 均正交，证明 (1) $\beta_{1}, \beta_{2}$ 线性相关；(2) $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}, \beta_{1}$ 线性无关.
解析:
(1)(用秩) 构造矩阵

$$
\mathbf {A} = \left[ \begin{array}{l} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \\ \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \\ \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \end{array} \right],
$$

则矩阵 $\mathbf{A}$ 是秩为3的 $3\times 4$ 矩阵.由于

$$
\mathbf {A} \pmb {\beta} _ {i} = \left[ \begin{array}{l} \pmb {\alpha} _ {1} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \\ \pmb {\alpha} _ {2} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \\ \pmb {\alpha} _ {3} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \end{array} \right] \pmb {\beta} _ {i} = \left[ \begin{array}{l} 0 \\ 0 \\ 0 \end{array} \right], i = 1, 2,
$$

所以 $\pmb{\beta}_{1},\pmb{\beta}_{2}$ 均是齐次方程组 $Ax = 0$ 的解，于是

$$
r (\pmb {\beta} _ {1}, \pmb {\beta} _ {2}) \leqslant n - r (\mathbf {A}) = 4 - 3 = 1,
$$

从而 $\beta_{1}, \beta_{2}$ 线性相关.

(2)(用定义)设

$$
k _ {1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + k _ {2} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} + k _ {3} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3} + k \boldsymbol {\beta} _ {1} = \mathbf {0},\tag{①}
$$

用 $\pmb{\beta}_{1}^{\mathrm{T}}$ 左乘 ①，又 $\pmb{\beta}_{1}^{\mathrm{T}}\pmb{\alpha}_{i}=0(i=1,2,3)$ ，有 $k\pmb{\beta}_{1}^{\mathrm{T}}\pmb{\beta}_{1}=0$ 。而 $\pmb{\beta}_{1}^{\mathrm{T}}\pmb{\beta}_{1}\neq0$ ，故必有 $k=0$ 。把 $k=0$ 代入 ① 得

$$
k _ {1} \pmb {\alpha} _ {1} + k _ {2} \pmb {\alpha} _ {2} + k _ {3} \pmb {\alpha} _ {3} = \mathbf {0},
$$

因 $\pmb{\alpha}_{1},\pmb{\alpha}_{2},\pmb{\alpha}_{3}$ 线性无关，故必有

$$
k _ {1} = 0, k _ {2} = 0, k _ {3} = 0,
$$

所以 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\beta_{1}$ 必线性无关.

题目内容: 【练习】1 已知 $\lambda_{1}, \lambda_{2}$ 是矩阵 $A$ 不同的特征值, $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}$ 是特征值 $\lambda_{1}$ 的线性无关的特征向量, $\beta$ 是特征值 $\lambda_{2}$ 的特征向量. 证明 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \beta$ 线性无关.
【练习】2 证明: 如果 $\beta_{1}, \beta_{2}, \beta_{3}$ 可由 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}$ 线性表示, 则 $\beta_{1}, \beta_{2}, \beta_{3}$ 必线性相关.

【练习】3 已知 $A = [\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{m}]$ , $B = [\beta_{1}, \beta_{2}, \cdots, \beta_{m}]$ 且 PA = B，其中 P 是可逆矩阵，若 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{3}, \alpha_{5}$ 线性相（无）关，则 $\beta_{1}, \beta_{3}, \beta_{5}$ 线性相（无）关。
【例3.10】已知向量组 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}$ 线性无关，向量组 $\alpha_{1} + a\alpha_{2}, \alpha_{1} + 2\alpha_{2} + \alpha_{3}, a\alpha_{1} - \alpha_{3}$ 线性相关，则 a = ____.
解析:
令

$$
\boldsymbol {\beta} _ {1} = \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + a \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\beta} _ {2} = \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + 2 \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} + \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}, \boldsymbol {\beta} _ {3} = a \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} - \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3},
$$

有

$$
[ \pmb {\beta} _ {1}, \pmb {\beta} _ {2}, \pmb {\beta} _ {3} ] = [ \pmb {\alpha} _ {1}, \pmb {\alpha} _ {2}, \pmb {\alpha} _ {3} ] \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 1 & a \\ a & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & - 1 \end{array} \right],
$$

从而

$$
\left| \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 1 & a \\ a & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & - 1 \end{array} \right| = \left| \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & a + 1 & a \\ a & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right| = a ^ {2} + a - 2 = 0,
$$

故 a = 1 或 a = -2.

或用定义法. 如

$$
k _ {1} \left(\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + a \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}\right) + k _ {2} \left(\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + 2 \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} + \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}\right) + k _ {3} \left(a \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} - \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}\right) = \mathbf {0},\tag{①}
$$

$$
\mathfrak {I} \left(k _ {1} + k _ {2} + a k _ {3}\right) \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + \left(a k _ {1} + 2 k _ {2}\right) \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} + \left(k _ {2} - k _ {3}\right) \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3} = \mathbf {0}.\tag{②}
$$

由 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 线性无关.从而

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{c} k _ {1} + k _ {2} + a k _ {3} = 0, \\ a k _ {1} + 2 k _ {2} = 0, \\ k _ {2} - k _ {3} = 0, \end{array} \right.\tag{③}
$$

因 $k_{1}, k_{2}, k_{3}$ 不全为0，即 ③ 必有非零解，故

$$
\left| \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 1 & a \\ a & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & - 1 \end{array} \right| = a ^ {2} + a - 2 = 0,
$$

故 $a = 1$ 或 $a = -2$ .

定理 3.4 向量 $\beta$ 可由向量组 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{s}$ 线性表出

定理 3.6 如果 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{s}$ 线性无关， $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{s}, \beta$ 线性相关，则 $\beta$ 可由 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{s}$ 线性表出，且表示法唯一.

定理 3.7 如果向量组 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{s}$ 可由向量组 $\beta_{1}, \beta_{2}, \cdots, \beta_{t}$ 线性表出，而且 s > t，那么 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{s}$ 线性相关。即如果多数向量能用少数向量线性表出，那么多数向量一定线性相关。

推论 如果 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{s}$ 线性无关，且它可由 $\beta_{1}, \beta_{2}, \cdots, \beta_{t}$ 线性表出，则 $s \leqslant t$ .

题目内容: 【例3.13】（2005,2）确定常数 a，使向量组 $\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{1}=(1,1,a)^{\mathrm{T}},\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{2}=(1,a,1)^{\mathrm{T}},\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{3}=(a,1,1)^{\mathrm{T}}$ 可由向量组 $\boldsymbol{\beta}_{1}=(1,1,a)^{\mathrm{T}},\boldsymbol{\beta}_{2}=(-2,a,4)^{\mathrm{T}}$ ， $\boldsymbol{\beta}_{3}=(-2,a,a)^{\mathrm{T}}$ 线性表示，但向量组 $\beta_{1},\beta_{2},\beta_{3}$ 不能由向量组 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 线性表示.
解析:
（方法一）因为 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 可由 $\beta_{1},\beta_{2},\beta_{3}$ 线性表出，有 $r(\alpha_1,\alpha_2,\alpha_3)\leqslant r(\beta_1,\beta_2,\beta_3).$ 

又因为 $\pmb{\beta}_{1},\pmb{\beta}_{2},\pmb{\beta}_{3}$ 不能由 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 线性表出，故必有

$$
r (\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}) <   r (\boldsymbol {\beta} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {\beta} _ {2}, \boldsymbol {\beta} _ {3}).
$$

由于 $r(\pmb{\beta}_1, \pmb{\beta}_2, \pmb{\beta}_3) \leqslant 3$ ，故 $r(\pmb{\alpha}_1, \pmb{\alpha}_2, \pmb{\alpha}_3) < 3$ ，于是

$$
| \pmb {\alpha} _ {1}, \pmb {\alpha} _ {2}, \pmb {\alpha} _ {3} | = \left| \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 1 & a \\ 1 & a & 1 \\ a & 1 & 1 \end{array} \right| = - (a + 2) (a - 1) ^ {2} = 0,
$$

所以 a = 1 或 a = -2.

若 $a = 1$ ，有 $\pmb{\alpha}_{1} = \pmb{\alpha}_{2} = \pmb{\alpha}_{3} = \pmb{\beta}_{1}$ ，即 $\pmb{\alpha}_{1},\pmb{\alpha}_{2},\pmb{\alpha}_{3}$ 可由 $\pmb{\beta}_{1},\pmb{\beta}_{2},\pmb{\beta}_{3}$ 线性表出，

若 $a = -2$ ，易见

$$
r (\pmb {\alpha} _ {1}, \pmb {\alpha} _ {2}, \pmb {\alpha} _ {3}) = r \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & 1 & - 2 \\ 1 & - 2 & 1 \\ - 2 & 1 & 1 \end{array} \right] = 2,
$$

$$
r (\pmb {\beta} _ {1}, \pmb {\beta} _ {2}, \pmb {\beta} _ {3}) = r \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} 1 & - 2 & - 2 \\ 1 & - 2 & - 2 \\ - 2 & 4 & - 2 \end{array} \right] = 2,

(方法二) $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 可由 $\beta_{1},\beta_{2},\beta_{3}$ 线性表出，即三个方程组

$$
x _ {1 j} \pmb {\beta} _ {1} + x _ {2 j} \pmb {\beta} _ {2} + x _ {3 j} \pmb {\beta} _ {3} = \pmb {\alpha} _ {j}, (j = 1, 2, 3)

【例3.14】已知 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{s}, \beta_{1}, \beta_{2}, \cdots, \beta_{s-1}$ 都是 n 维向量，下列命题中错误的是

学习札记
选项A: 如果 $\begin{bmatrix}\alpha_{1}\\ \beta_{1}\end{bmatrix},\begin{bmatrix}\alpha_{2}\\ \beta_{2}\end{bmatrix},\cdots,\begin{bmatrix}\alpha_{s-1}\\ \beta_{s-1}\end{bmatrix}$ 线性相关，则 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{s-1},\alpha_{s}$ 线性相关.
选项B: 如果秩 $r(\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{1}, \boldsymbol{\alpha}_{2}, \cdots, \boldsymbol{\alpha}_{s}, \boldsymbol{\beta}_{1}, \boldsymbol{\beta}_{2}, \cdots, \boldsymbol{\beta}_{s-1}) = r(\boldsymbol{\beta}_{1}, \boldsymbol{\beta}_{2}, \cdots, \boldsymbol{\beta}_{s-1})$ ，则 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{s}$ 线性相关.
选项C: 如果 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{s}$ 线性相关，且 $\alpha_{s}$ 不能由 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{s-1}$ 线性表出，则 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{s-1}$ 线性相关.
选项D: 如果 $\alpha_{s}$ 不能由 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{s-1}$ 线性表出，则 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{s}$ 线性无关.
解析:
当 $\alpha_{s}$ 不能由 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{s-1}$ 线性表出时，并不能保证每一个向量 $\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{i} (i = 1, 2, \cdots, s-1)$ 都不能用其余的向量线性表出。例如， $\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{1} = (1, 0, 0)^{\mathrm{T}}, \boldsymbol{\alpha}_{2} = (2, 0, 0)^{\mathrm{T}}, \boldsymbol{\alpha}_{3} = (0, 0, 3)^{\mathrm{T}}$ ，虽然 $\alpha_{3}$ 不能由 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}$ 线性表出，但 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}$ 是线性相关的。所以（D）不正确。

关于(A)，由 $\begin{bmatrix}\alpha_{1}\\ \beta_{1}\end{bmatrix},\begin{bmatrix}\alpha_{2}\\ \beta_{2}\end{bmatrix},\cdots,\begin{bmatrix}\alpha_{s-1}\\ \beta_{s-1}\end{bmatrix}$ 线性相关 $\xrightarrow{定理3.3}\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{s-1}$ 线性相关 $\xrightarrow{定理3.2}\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{s-1},\alpha_{s}$ 线性相关.

关于(B), $r(\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{1},\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{2},\cdots,\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{s})\leqslant r(\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{1},\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{2},\cdots,\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{s},\boldsymbol{\beta}_{1},\boldsymbol{\beta}_{2},\cdots,\boldsymbol{\beta}_{s-1})$ $=r(\boldsymbol{\beta}_{1},\boldsymbol{\beta}_{2},\cdots,\boldsymbol{\beta}_{s-1})\leqslant s-1<s.$ 

或者，由 $r(\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{1},\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{2},\cdots,\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{s},\boldsymbol{\beta}_{1},\boldsymbol{\beta}_{2},\cdots,\boldsymbol{\beta}_{s-1})=r(\boldsymbol{\beta}_{1},\boldsymbol{\beta}_{2},\cdots,\boldsymbol{\beta}_{s-1})$ 知 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{s}$ 可由 $\beta_{1},\beta_{2},\cdots,\beta_{s-1}$ 线性表出，据定理 3.7 亦知 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{s}$ 线性相关.

对于(C)，由于 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{s}$ 线性相关，故存在不全为0的 $k_{1},k_{2},\cdots,k_{s}$ 使得 $k_{1}\alpha_{1}+k_{2}\alpha_{2}+\cdots+k_{s}\alpha_{s}=0$ 。此时必有 $k_{s}=0$ ，否则 $\alpha_{s}$ 可由 $\alpha_{1},\cdots,\alpha_{s-1}$ 线性表出。于是 $k_{1},k_{2},\cdots,k_{s-1}$ 不全为0，而 $k_{1}\alpha_{1}+k_{2}\alpha_{2}+\cdots+k_{s-1}\alpha_{s-1}=0$ ，即 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{s-1}$ 必线性相关。

(1) $\alpha_{1}$ 能由 $\alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}$ 线性表出.

（方法一）因为已知向量组 $\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3},\alpha_{4}$ 线性无关，那么它的部分组 $\alpha_{2}$ ， $\alpha_{3}$ 线性无关(定理3.2).又因 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 线性相关，故 $\alpha_{1}$ 可以由 $\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 线性表出(定理3.6).

（方法二）因为向量组 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 线性相关，故存在不全为零的数 $k_{1},k_{2},$ $k_{3}$ ，使得 $k_{1}\pmb{\alpha}_{1} + k_{2}\pmb{\alpha}_{2} + k_{3}\pmb{\alpha}_{3} = \mathbf{0}$ ，其中必有 $k_{1}\neq 0.$ 否则，若 $k_{1} = 0$ ，则 $k_{2},k_{3}$ 不全为零，使 $k_{2}\pmb{\alpha}_{2} + k_{3}\pmb{\alpha}_{3} = \mathbf{0}$ ，即 $\pmb{\alpha}_{2},\pmb{\alpha}_{3}$ 线性相关，进而向量组 $\pmb{\alpha}_{2},\pmb{\alpha}_{3},\pmb{\alpha}_{4}$ 线性相关(定理3.2)，与已知矛盾.于是 $k_{1}\neq 0$ ，由此有 $\pmb{\alpha}_{1} = -\frac{k_{2}}{k_{1}}\pmb{\alpha}_{2} - \frac{k_{3}}{k_{1}}\pmb{\alpha}_{3}$ ，即 $\pmb{\alpha}_{1}$ 可由 $\pmb{\alpha}_{2},\pmb{\alpha}_{3}$ 线性表出.

(2) $\alpha_{4}$ 不能由 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}$ 线性表出.

(方法一) (反证法) 若 $\alpha_{4}$ 能由 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}$ 线性表出, 设

$$
\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {4} = k _ {1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + k _ {2} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} + k _ {3} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3}.
$$

由(1)知, $\alpha_{1}=l_{2}\alpha_{2}+l_{3}\alpha_{3}$ ，代入上式整理，得到

$$
\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {4} = \left(k _ {1} l _ {2} + k _ {2}\right) \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} + \left(k _ {1} l _ {3} + k _ {3}\right) \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {3},
$$

即 $\alpha_{4}$ 可由 $\alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}$ 线性表出，从而 $\alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}, \alpha_{4}$ 线性相关（定理 3.5），与已知矛盾。因此， $\alpha_{4}$ 不能由 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \alpha_{3}$ 线性表出。

（方法二）考查方程组 $x_{1}\pmb{\alpha}_{1} + x_{2}\pmb{\alpha}_{2} + x_{3}\pmb{\alpha}_{3} = \pmb{\alpha}_{4}$ ，因为 $\pmb{\alpha}_{1},\pmb{\alpha}_{2},\pmb{\alpha}_{3}$ 线性相关，故系数矩阵的秩 $r(\mathbf{A}) = r(\pmb{\alpha}_1,\pmb{\alpha}_2,\pmb{\alpha}_3) < 3.$ 又因 $\pmb{\alpha}_{2},\pmb{\alpha}_{3},\pmb{\alpha}_{4}$ 线性无关，故增广矩阵的秩 $r(\pmb{\alpha}_1,\pmb{\alpha}_2,\pmb{\alpha}_3,\pmb{\alpha}_4)\geqslant 3.$ 于是 $r(\mathbf{A})\neq r(\overline{\mathbf{A}})$ ，方程组无解，因此， $\pmb{\alpha}_{4}$ 不能由 $\pmb{\alpha}_{1},\pmb{\alpha}_{2},\pmb{\alpha}_{3}$ 线性表出.

题目内容:
【例3.16】设向量 $\beta$ 可以由向量组 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{m}$ 线性表出，但 $\beta$ 不能由向量组 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{m-1}$ 线性表出。判断

(1) $\alpha_{m}$ 能否由 $\alpha_{1}, \cdots, \alpha_{m-1}, \beta$ 线性表出，为什么？

(2) $\alpha_{m}$ 能否由 $\alpha_{1}, \cdots, \alpha_{m-1}$ 线性表出，为什么？
解析:
(1) $\alpha_{m}$ 可以由 $\alpha_{1},\cdots,\alpha_{m-1},\beta$ 线性表出.

因为 $\beta$ 可以由 $\alpha_{1},\cdots,\alpha_{m}$ 线性表出，故可设

$$
\boldsymbol {\beta} = l _ {1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + \dots + l _ {m - 1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {m - 1} + l _ {m} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {m}.\tag{①}
$$

此时必有 $l_{m} \neq 0$ ，否则 $\beta$ 可以由 $\alpha_{1}, \cdots, \alpha_{m-1}$ 线性表出，与已知矛盾。那么

$$
\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {m} = \frac {1}{l _ {m}} (\boldsymbol {\beta} - l _ {1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} - \dots - l _ {m - 1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {m - 1}),
$$

即 $\alpha_{m}$ 可以由 $\alpha_{1},\cdots,\alpha_{m-1},\beta$ 线性表出.

(2) $\alpha_{m}$ 不能由 $\alpha_{1},\cdots,\alpha_{m-1}$ 线性表出.

如果 $\alpha_{m}$ 可以由 $\alpha_{1},\cdots,\alpha_{m-1}$ 线性表出，可设

$$
\boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {m} = k _ {1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {1} + k _ {2} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {2} + \dots + k _ {m - 1} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {m - 1}.\tag{②}
$$

将 ② 代入 ①, 整理得

$$

题目内容:
【例3.27】设 $\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{1}=(1,2,-a)^{\mathrm{T}},\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{2}=(1,1,2)^{\mathrm{T}},\boldsymbol{\beta}_{1}=(a,5,10)^{\mathrm{T}}$ ， $\boldsymbol{\beta}_{2}=(4,a,1)^{\mathrm{T}}$ 。若 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\beta_{1},\beta_{2}$ 生成的向量空间 $L(\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\beta_{1},\beta_{2})$ ，维数是 2。(1) 求 a；

(2) 证明 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}$ 和 $\beta_{1}, \beta_{2}$ 都是 $L(\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \beta_{1}, \beta_{2})$ 的基，并求由基 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}$ 到 $\beta_{1}, \beta_{2}$ 的过渡矩阵.
解析:
$L(\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{1},\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{2},\boldsymbol{\beta}_{1},\boldsymbol{\beta}_{2})$ 是二维向量空间 $\Leftrightarrow$ 秩 $r(\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{1},\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{2},\boldsymbol{\beta}_{1},\boldsymbol{\beta}_{2})=2.$ 

(1) 对 $(\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\beta_{1},\beta_{2})$ 作初等行变换

$$
\left[\begin{array}{c c c c}1&1&a&4\\2&1&5&a\\- a&2&1 0&1\end{array}\right]\rightarrow \left[\begin{array}{c c c c}1&0&5 - a&a - 4\\0&1&2 a - 5&8 - a\\0&0&- (a + 4) (a - 5)&(a + 3) (a - 5)\end{array}\right].
$$

由 $\left\{\begin{aligned}(a+4)(a-5)&=0\\ (a+3)(a-5)&=0\end{aligned}\right.$ ，故a=5.

(2) 因 $\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{1}=(1,2,-5)^{\mathrm{T}},\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{2}=(1,1,2)^{\mathrm{T}}$ 线性无关. 又 $r(\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{1},\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{2},\boldsymbol{\beta}_{1},\boldsymbol{\beta}_{2})=2$ , 那么 $\beta_{1},\beta_{2}$ 必可由 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2}$ 线性表出.

那么 $\forall \gamma = k_{1}\pmb{\alpha}_{1} + k_{2}\pmb{\alpha}_{2} + l_{1}\pmb{\beta}_{1} + l_{2}\pmb{\beta}_{2}\in L(\pmb{\alpha}_{1},\pmb{\alpha}_{2},\pmb{\beta}_{1},\pmb{\beta}_{2})$ 必可由 $\pmb{\alpha}_{1},\pmb{\alpha}_{2}$ 线性表出.所以 $\pmb{\alpha}_{1},\pmb{\alpha}_{2}$ 是生成向量空间 $L(\pmb{\alpha}_{1},\pmb{\alpha}_{2},\pmb{\beta}_{1},\pmb{\beta}_{2})$ 的基.类似地 $\pmb{\beta}_{1} = (5,5,10)^{\mathrm{T}},\pmb{\beta}_{2} = (4,5,1)^{\mathrm{T}}$ 也是生成的向量空间的基.

将 $a = 5$ 代入 $(\pmb{\alpha}_1, \pmb{\alpha}_2, \pmb{\beta}_1, \pmb{\beta}_2)$ 

$$
(\pmb {\alpha} _ {1}, \pmb {\alpha} _ {2}, \pmb {\beta} _ {1}, \pmb {\beta} _ {2}) \rightarrow \left[\begin{array}{c c c c}1&0&0&1\\&1&5&3\\&&&0\end{array}\right],
$$

即 $\pmb{\beta}_{1} = 5\pmb{\alpha}_{2},\pmb{\beta}_{2} = \pmb{\alpha}_{1} + 3\pmb{\alpha}_{2}$ ，所以由基 $\pmb{\alpha}_{1},\pmb{\alpha}_{2}$ 到基 $\pmb{\beta}_{1},\pmb{\beta}_{2}$ 的过渡矩阵

$$
\boldsymbol {C} = \left[ \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ 5 & 3 \end{array} \right].
$$
